notes.title: Update #6
notes.notes:
Hello!

Before starting to make the next game, we decided to deliver an update!

[b]List of improvements:[/b]
[list]
[*]Added footstep VFX (dust)
[*]Added hit reaction animations for both character and enemies 
[*]Improved lighting on the city level
[*]Reduced game size
[*]Fixed bug with the character selection
[*]You can enter aim mode when sprinting
[*]Fixed some AI paths
[*]Fixed AI walking around movement
[*]Added reaper light fade animation when killed
[*]Remaded character fire animations
[*]Added sniper zoom in/out sounds
[*]Added weapon fire animations
[*]Added weapon shells
[/list]

notes.title: Update #4 - added photo mode
Update #3 - Added gamepad support
notes.notes:
Hello!

The game now fully supports gamepad controllers (added user interface interaction + vibration in game). There was added a bald haircut style on request. Small fixes also were made in this update. Enjoy!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38783393/64031e134bc97da029db7563c54b0db9340847ec.png[/img]

notes.title: Update #2
notes.notes:
Hello,

there are list of changes in the second update:
[list]
[*] Added photo mode (use Gamepad/Mouse or W,A,S,D and Q,E to move the camera)
[*] Added controls menu inside settings
[*] Added option to switch on/off sprint instead of hold the key
[*] In course of time zombies become stronger inside survival mode
[*] Fixed some AI paths on the pirate map
[*] Small fixes in character materials
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38783393/41435c593265d98980be50590e72210e9734dbbd.png[/img]

notes.title: Update #1
Game update + info
notes.notes:
Hello!

The game was updated since the video traler came out. There was a bunch of visual fixes and the most important thing (for my opinion) is the grenade launcher. You can find it in various places on the maps. It's challenging and satisfying to shoot grenades at a distance :)

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38783393/6adeca3b3b4f32edc936ee98e5e4d5c34405a487.png[/img]

If you like how the game looks, please add it to your wishlist. I'll be grateful for this.
